deviations.result: Real frames went from 2.0-2.7 dB short to 0.46-0.71 dB short; level under noise.

notes: Diagnosis first: the four directional pictures were scored separately, averaged, chosen by the old rule, and chosen by an oracle. The L*a*b* homogeneity choice was no better than a plain average (36.38 vs 36.39 dB on X-E1), while the oracle reached 40.03. Fix: clamp each directional green between the two greens it was interpolated from, and replace the choice with a second-difference blend, weights (Dmin/D)^4. Colour PSNR, X-E1 36.60->38.56 (LibRaw 3-pass 39.27); held-out X-E2 47.88->49.43 (49.89); sheet 33.51->35.00 (39.37). Noisy known truth added (--noise-snr): X-E2 at SNR 25 is 0.12 dB ahead of LibRaw. The real-data luma gap was traced to the median step. Checks: tests/test_xtrans_demosaic.py 13 pass (numpy venv); run_venture_tests.py photo-editing ok (104.7 s); ruff check clean; mypy has only the error already on main (dng_opcodes.py:1000); post front matter, links and similarity clean.
